decisions.reason: As a publicly announced flagship product line with several models and heavy investment, close to the core business, dropping it would write off major investment and contradict the firm's stated digital direction.
The education institute builds on the established training resources, strengthens customer ties and has been visibly maintained since 2018, so the firm has little reason to abandon it.
Remote support tooling is cheap to maintain, is embedded in the firm's support operations and remains useful, so dropping it would release little and disrupt service.
The analytics dashboard was given its own page and fits the announced direction toward efficiently managed, connected practices, so the commitment and fit favor persistence.
The complete practice bundle packages core offerings close to the established business, so keeping it costs little and it was presented prominently.

The job portal is distant from the core offer and was only mentioned, so it carries little public commitment, but its low maintenance cost and community value make retention somewhat more likely than a drop.
